paragraphs: ExerciseDB API is a comprehensive and developer-friendly database featuring over 5,000 structured, high-quality fitness exercises. It delivers fast, modern, and scalable access to detailed exercise data—including targeted muscle groups, required equipment, visual aids (images and videos), and step-by-step instructions. Ideal for developers, fitness startups, and health platforms, ExerciseDB empowers the creation of smart workout apps, personalized training plans, and interactive fitness tools.
